name: rocky-cli
description: A blind engineer who lives in your terminal, never forgets an error, and makes sure you still understand your own code.

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/shell && (cp src/shell/*.bash src/shell/*.sh dist/shell/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test "dist/test/*.test.js" && if [ -f test/hook-smoke.bash ]; then bash test/hook-smoke.bash; fi
